source: Project Operating System Phase 3.5 - Governance Hardening
description: Approval matrix for future technical testing decisions.

requiredApprovalItems.description: Expected and obtained results must match within defined tolerance.
Every required test in the suite must pass.
Runtime behavior and runtime files must remain safe.
SEO metadata, canonical behavior, indexability and URLs must remain safe.
Layout-critical behavior must remain equivalent or approved.
Current evidence must match the stored baseline within tolerance.
A human decision must approve the evidence.

approveWhen: All required approval items pass and manual approval is recorded.
rejectWhen: Any required item fails, is missing, or has unclear evidence.
notes: No component can be considered approved without satisfying this matrix.
The matrix is declarative and does not enforce approval automatically in Phase 3.
